title: Settings
carerAvailabilityEmpty: No nanny in this household yet
carerAvailabilityNone: Your nanny hasn't shared availability yet
carerTimeOffHint: Booked time off — status only; approval isn't in the app yet.
deleteAccountConfirmBody: This permanently deletes your account and profile. It does not delete your household's shared records — hours worked and approved timesheets stay in that history for the other people in your household. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAccountConsequenceAccount: Your account and profile are removed.
deleteAccountConsequenceKeeps: Hours worked and approved timesheets stay for your household.

time.title: Time & calendar
time.subtitle: How times and weekday selectors appear for you. Hours and timesheets still use Monday weeks for the household.
time.timezoneHint: Used when showing absolute times. Shift records stay in UTC.
time.weekStartsHint: Reorders day selectors only. Shared schedules and Hours weeks still start on Monday.

calendarSync.toggleLabel: Add my shifts to my calendar
calendarSync.toggleHint: Your shifts show up in the calendar you already use. Steadily is the source of truth — edits made in your calendar app will be overwritten on the next sync.
calendarSync.emptyTitle: No Google or Outlook calendar found on this device
calendarSync.emptyBody: Add the account in Settings → Calendar → Accounts, then come back here. Having the Google Calendar app installed on its own isn't enough — iOS needs the account too.
calendarSync.useLocalAnyway: Use "On My iPhone" / local calendar anyway
calendarSync.permissionDeniedHint: Calendar access is off. Turn it on in iOS Settings → Steadily.
calendarSync.disconnectBody: This deletes Steadily events from that calendar. Your other events are untouched.
calendarSync.successToast: Your shifts are in {{label}}. Changes will sync automatically.

notificationsSoftAsk.title: Stay in the loop
notificationsSoftAsk.body: Turn on notifications for timely reminders and updates. You can change this anytime in Settings.

notificationsPermissionDenied.title: Notifications are off
notificationsPermissionDenied.body: Enable notifications in Settings to get reminders and updates.

notificationPrefs.title: Notifications
notificationPrefs.subtitle: Choose which updates you get and when quiet hours apply. Time-sensitive requests still come through during quiet hours.
notificationPrefs.quietHoursHint: Mute non-urgent pushes overnight. Shift confirmations and change requests still deliver.
notificationPrefs.typesHint: Turn off types you do not want. System permission is managed separately below.
notificationPrefs.openOsSettingsHint: Control whether Steadily can alert you at the OS level.
